definitions.explanation: A shirt or garment style with the collar worn open, without a tie or buttoned-up neckline. Refers especially to the open-collar dress shirts commonly worn in summer in Japan.

examples.japanese: {開襟|かいきん}⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
⟦{夏場|なつば}→夏場：28060_natsuba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{開襟|かいきん}⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出勤|しゅっきん}→出勤：04548_shukkin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In summer, many people go to work in open-collar shirts.

examples.japanese: ⟦クールビズ→クールビズ：29551_kuurubizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}→普及：07592_fukyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{開襟|かいきん}⟦スタイル→スタイル：03851_sutairu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{定着|ていちゃく}→定着：07594_teichaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The spread of Cool Biz has established the open-collar style.

notes:
Combines {開|かい} (open) + {襟|きん} (collar). Most commonly seen in the compound {開襟|かいきん}⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧.

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ⟦{解禁|かいきん}→解禁：14144_kaikin⟧ (lifting a ban), which has the same reading but different kanji and meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開襟|かいきん}⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧: open-collar shirt
- {開襟|かいきん}⟦スタイル→スタイル：03851_sutairu⟧: open-collar style

CULTURAL NOTE:
The {開襟|かいきん} style became widespread in Japan after the government launched "⟦クールビズ→クールビズ：29551_kuurubizu⟧" (Cool Biz) in 2005, encouraging office workers to dress casually in summer to reduce air conditioning use. During the Cool Biz period (typically May–September), wearing an {開襟|かいきん}⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧ without a tie is standard in many workplaces.
